QuestInfo.name: The Final Ingredient for the Cure
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p404# in #m10003000# still needs something else.
QuestInfo.1: Claiming that he needs the final ingredient for the #o17# phobia cure, #p404# in #m10003000# asked me to go get a #t4031113# from his grandfather, #b#p111##k in #b#m10000000##k. To think that #p111# was #p404#'s grandfather... \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: #p111# in #m10000000# handed over the #t4031113# with a suspicious look. Will this really be, okay?

0.0: Great. But we're still missing the most important ingredient for the #o17# cure. Could you go to #b#p111##k in #m10000000# and get a #b#t4031113##k? If we have that, I think we can really make the cure.

yes.0: What? How do I know #p111# has a #t4031113#? Well, isn't it obvious? #p111# is my grandfather. He's someone who can't live without those gummies.

no.0: Tsk, so you're getting tired of this now, are you?

1.0: What business do you have with me? I see... So my grandson asked you to get a #t4031113# from me. Goodness, what on earth is that boy plotting this time...

npc.0: We're almost done here. Hurry to #m10000000# and get the #t4031113# from my grandfather, #p111#. Once you do, I'll make that #o17# phobia cure for you.
